                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function key_comp() of class ara::core::Map provides the internal comparison object for keys ([SWS_CORE_01488]). It is included via the header #include "ara/core/map.h" and follows the usual semantics of the C++ standard container std::map ([SWS_CORE_01488]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The method has the signature key_compare key_comp () const; ([SWS_CORE_01488]). The call is executed synchronously on an instance of ara::core::Map and requires no parameters ([SWS_CORE_01488]). As a return value, the function returns a function object of type key_compare, which is used for ordering and comparing the keys in the container ([SWS_CORE_01488]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Regarding exception safety, the function is explicitly classified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_01488]). Specific error codes, return values for error indication, or DET or DEM notifications are not provided in the specification ([SWS_CORE_01488]). Interpretation: The classification as not exception-safe is likely due to the fact that an exception may be thrown when copying the comparison object during return.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As a const-qualified method, key_comp() does not modify the state of the calling ara::core::Map object ([SWS_CORE_01488]). Interpretation: Parallel read calls on the same instance should be executable concurrently without additional synchronization, provided that no concurrent modifying accesses take place.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    The member function lower_bound of class ara::core::Map from header ara/core/map.h looks up the first entry whose key is not less than the passed argument x [SWS_CORE_01498]. The call is performed synchronously on a non-const instance and returns a mutable iterator to the found element or the end of the container. The functional behavior follows the corresponding semantics of [map] [SWS_CORE_01498].
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    According to the specification, the function is classified as not exception safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_01498]. Specific error codes, return values for error states, or reports to diagnostic or error managers are not defined in the payload.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    Since the call returns a modifiable iterator to the internal data structure, concurrent access to the same instance without separate protection is likely not concurrency-safe or thread-safe.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction with Related Interfaces
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    The function is part of a family of lookup operations within ara::core::Map:
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For read access on const containers, the overload with const key_type & exists, which returns a const_iterator [SWS_CORE_01499].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For heterogeneous search keys of arbitrary types K, template-based overloads are available both for mutable instances [SWS_CORE_01500] and for const instances [SWS_CORE_01501].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function lower_bound [SWS_CORE_01499]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  const_iterator lower_bound (const key_type &x) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The const member function lower_bound of class ara::core::Map serves according to [SWS_CORE_01499] to find the first element whose key does not precede the passed key value. The call is synchronous and is provided via header #include "ara/core/map.h". The semantics follow the corresponding usage in std::map according to [SWS_CORE_01499].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Parameters and Return Value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The function accepts a constant reference const key_type &x to the searched key as a parameter. As a return value, it returns a const_iterator to the found element, or the end iterator if no matching entry is present. Since this is a const-qualified method, the returned iterator does not permit modifying access to the referenced elements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Restrictions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding exception safety, the method is expressly declared in the specification as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_01499]. Callers can thus not rely on guaranteed state preservation when errors or exceptions occur (such as during user-defined comparison operations).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interaction with related functions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Within ara::core::Map, complementary overloads of lower_bound exist:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [SWS_CORE_01498] offers the non-const variant iterator lower_bound (const key_type &x) for modifiable instances.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [SWS_CORE_01500] and [SWS_CORE_01501] provide function templates template <class K> lower_bound (const K &x) that enable a search with compatible, alternative key types.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The template member function lower_bound belongs to the scope of class ara::core::Map and is provided via header file ara/core/map.h [SWS_CORE_01500]. It accepts a reference parameter const K &x and returns a modifiable iterator to the found element [SWS_CORE_01500]. The semantics are stated in the specification as “As per corresponding usage in [map]” [SWS_CORE_01500]. Interpretation: This is likely to mean that the call synchronously addresses the first element whose key does not precede x in terms of the ordering relation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Boundary Conditions

Further explicit requirements regarding reentrancy or the call context are not defined in the sources.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Within ara::core::Map, the function forms the modifiable counterpart to the const template search function with const_iterator [SWS_CORE_01501]. Both generic variants complement the non-templated overloads for keys of type key_type, which are available as a mutable iterator [SWS_CORE_01498] and as const_iterator [SWS_CORE_01499], and share the same exception classification.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The template member function lower_bound of ara::core::Map serves for key-based lookup on a const instance of the map [SWS_CORE_01501]. It is declared via header ara/core/map.h and returns a const_iterator to the found element [SWS_CORE_01501].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Usage and Semantics: The function takes a search key const K &x. According to the specification, the behavior corresponds to the usual semantics in [map] [SWS_CORE_01501]. Interpretation: By parameterizing over the type K, heterogeneous key lookup is likely supported, in which no temporary object of the key type needs to be created, provided a matching comparison operator exists. Since this is a const member function, the state of the container remains unchanged.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Exception Safety: No specific error codes or DET/DEM messages are provided. In the specification, the function is explicitly declared as “not exception safe” [SWS_CORE_01501]. Interpretation: In the event of any errors during key comparison, exceptions are likely propagated directly to the caller without further container guarantees taking effect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interplay and Overloads: The function is part of a four-member overload family within ara::core::Map:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The present variant returns a const_iterator for generic keys [SWS_CORE_01501].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The non-const template overload returns a mutable iterator for generic keys [SWS_CORE_01500].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For direct queries with the exact key_type, non-generic variants exist as a mutable method [SWS_CORE_01498] and as a const method [SWS_CORE_01499].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The template member function merge of class ara::core::Map from header ara/core/map.h takes over entries from a source container [SWS_CORE_01486]. The call takes place synchronously via the signature template <class C2> void merge (Map< Key, T, C2, Allocator > &source) and provides no return value [SWS_CORE_01486]. Due to the template parameter C2, the passed lvalue reference source may have a different comparison operator, but must match in key, value, and allocator type [SWS_CORE_01486].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding behavior, the specification refers to the corresponding usage in [map] [SWS_CORE_01486]. Interpretation: The reference “As per corresponding usage in [map]” is likely to mean that elements are extracted from source and inserted into the calling instance without element copying, with key collisions remaining in source. Specific error codes, error messages, or monitoring mechanisms such as DET or DEM are not provided for the function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding error and exception safety, merge is explicitly classified as “not exception safe” [SWS_CORE_01486]. If an error occurs during the operation, the state of the involved containers is presumably not guaranteed to be consistent. Concurrent accesses to the same containers must be synchronized externally.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  In interaction with related interfaces, a complementary rvalue overload template <class C2> void merge (Map< Key, T, C2, Allocator > &&source) [SWS_CORE_01487] exists alongside this lvalue variant. This allows the direct merging of temporary instances or instances passed via move under identical specification conditions and is likewise classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_01487].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function merge [SWS_CORE_01487]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      template <class C2> void merge (Map< Key, T, C2, Allocator > &&source);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The template member function merge of class ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01487]), provided via header file #include "ara/core/map.h", serves for the synchronous merging of two maps. It takes over elements from the passed rvalue container source. Via the template parameter C2, the source map can have a differing comparison function type. The functional behavior is aligned entirely with the corresponding usage in [map] ([SWS_CORE_01487]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      With respect to robustness and error handling, the function is explicitly classified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_01487]). The return type is void. Specific error codes, return values, or error notifications to DET or DEM are not defined in the AUTOSAR payload. If an exception occurs during the insertion process or the key comparisons, both participating containers are likely to remain in an incomplete intermediate state, since restoration of the original state is not guaranteed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In the interplay of interfaces, [SWS_CORE_01487] forms the rvalue counterpart to the overload with a modifiable lvalue reference [SWS_CORE_01486]. While [SWS_CORE_01486] references existing lvalues, [SWS_CORE_01487] allows the direct and efficient passing of temporary instances or explicitly moved rvalues. The source container source is modified synchronously in the course of the operation, as its elements are transferred into the target map.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The function try_emplace of class ara::core::Map is provided via header ara/core/map.h [SWS_CORE_01472]. It serves the synchronous insertion of a new key-value pair. The function takes the key as a const reference const key_type& k and forwards variadic arguments Args&&... args for in-place construction of the associated value. As a return value, it returns a std::pair<iterator, bool>: the iterator points to the element with the specified key, while the boolean value indicates whether a new element was actually inserted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Restrictions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The specification explicitly classifies the operation as "not exception safe" [SWS_CORE_01472]. Specific error codes, error objects, or interfaces to DET or DEM are not provided in the module profile. Since no provisions for synchronization are defined, an unprotected concurrent call on the same map instance is likely not thread-safe (interpretation).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The semantics follows the corresponding behavior of [map] [SWS_CORE_01472], meaning that the value is likely constructed only if the key does not yet exist (interpretation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Usage and Call Context
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The template member function try_emplace of class ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01473]) serves the conditional insertion of a new element using an rvalue key (key_type&& k) and forwarded arguments (Args&&... args). As a return value, it synchronously returns a std::pair<iterator, bool> whose iterator points to the found or newly inserted element and whose boolean value indicates whether the key was newly inserted ([SWS_CORE_01473]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          According to the specification, the functional behavior follows the usage in [map] ([SWS_CORE_01473]). Interpretation: This is likely to mean that if the key already exists, neither an insertion nor the construction of the associated object takes place, and the passed rvalue key remains unchanged.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Boundary Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Regarding exception handling, the function is explicitly classified as “not exception safe” ([SWS_CORE_01473]). If an exception occurs during the allocation or construction process, no guarantees exist regarding the consistency of the container. Specific error codes or error channels via DET or DEM are not specified for this call ([SWS_CORE_01473]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction with Related Interfaces
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The function declared in header ara/core/map.h is complemented by further overloads of try_emplace ([SWS_CORE_01473]):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • [SWS_CORE_01472] binds the key as a const lvalue reference (const key_type& k) without a hint.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • [SWS_CORE_01474] and [SWS_CORE_01475] additionally accept an iterator hint (const_iterator hint) to optimize the insertion position for lvalue and rvalue keys, respectively, and directly return an iterator.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The template member function try_emplace of class ara::core::Map serves to insert an element while specifying a position hint [SWS_CORE_01474]. It is defined via header #include "ara/core/map.h" and accepts as parameters an iterator hint of type const_iterator, a constant key reference const key_type &k, and forwarding arguments Args &&... args for the value to be constructed [SWS_CORE_01474]. As a return value, the synchronous call returns a iterator to the element [SWS_CORE_01474].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Regarding the procedure, the specification refers to the corresponding usage in [map] [SWS_CORE_01474]. Interpretation: Here, the element is likely to be constructed directly only if the key k does not already exist in the map; if it already exists, the construction is omitted and an iterator to the existing entry is returned. The parameter hint presumably serves as an optimization hint to speed up the insertion process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              With regard to exception safety, the function is explicitly classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_01474]. Specific AUTOSAR error codes or messages to DET or DEM are not stated in the sources.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In the interplay within ara::core::Map, the function complements the related overloads:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The variant without a position hint with an lvalue key try_emplace(const key_type &k, Args &&... args) returns a std::pair<iterator, bool> [SWS_CORE_01472].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The overload for movable keys without a hint try_emplace(key_type &&k, Args &&... args) likewise returns a std::pair<iterator, bool> [SWS_CORE_01473].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The sibling function with a hint for rvalue keys try_emplace(const_iterator hint, key_type &&k, Args &&... args), like this overload, returns a plain iterator [SWS_CORE_01475].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Usage and Semantics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function upper_bound of class ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01502]) serves for synchronously finding elements in a sorted association. It takes a reference parameter x of type const key_type& and returns a mutable iterator. The functional semantics are specified as compliant with the usual usage in standard associative containers (“As per corresponding usage in [map]”) [SWS_CORE_01502]. Interpretation: The returned iterator thus points to the first element whose key is ordered strictly greater than the passed key x; if no such element exists, end() is presumably returned.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Boundary Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regarding execution safety, upper_bound is explicitly classified as not exception safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_01502]. Specific error codes, return values via ara::core::Result, or mechanisms such as DET/DEM are not defined for this operation. Because modifications or a lack of allocation and runtime guarantees must be taken into account, calling components must take precautions to catch or contain exceptions in the environment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The specification defines no reentrancy or thread-safety guarantees for concurrent accesses to the same instance of ara::core::Map [SWS_CORE_01502]. Because the function returns a mutable iterator through which the referenced value can be modified, concurrent read or write accesses without external synchronization are likely to lead to data races.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interplay and overloads
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The function is part of a family of search operations within ara::core::Map in header ara/core/map.h:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For purely reading instances, the const overload const_iterator upper_bound(const key_type& x) const is available [SWS_CORE_01503].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For transparent search queries with compatible comparison types K without mandatory conversion to key_type, template overloads exist for mutable iterators [SWS_CORE_01504] as well as for const accesses [SWS_CORE_01505].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        •

It accepts a reference key x of generic type K and synchronously returns a non-const iterator [SWS_CORE_01504]. The behavior corresponds to the reference semantics of std::map [SWS_CORE_01504]; the template form is likely intended to serve as a transparent lookup, allowing elements to be searched using compatible key types without having to create temporary instances of key_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              This function is specified to be not exception safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_01504]. Specific error codes, AUTOSAR-specific return values, or messages to DET or DEM are not defined for this call [SWS_CORE_01504]. If the predicate operator invoked during the comparison throws an exception, the implementation guarantees no exception safety [SWS_CORE_01504].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Because upper_bound returns a mutable iterator to the found element or the container end [SWS_CORE_01504], the call is intended for non-const instances of ara::core::Map. Due to the lack of synchronization mechanisms in the specification, the function is likely not thread-safe against concurrent modifications of the container.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The function complements the non-templated overload for exact instances of key_type [SWS_CORE_01502]. For read access to const instances of ara::core::Map, the corresponding const overloads returning a const_iterator also exist: on the one hand for const key_type &x [SWS_CORE_01503] and on the other hand for generic key types const K &x [SWS_CORE_01505].
