                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Usage and Semantics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The function upper_bound is a const template member function of class ara::core::Map and is provided via the header file ara/core/map.h [SWS_CORE_01505]. Via the template parameter K, the function takes a reference const K &x and returns a const_iterator [SWS_CORE_01505]. The execution semantics are specified with the reference “As per corresponding usage in [map]” [SWS_CORE_01505]. Interpretation: This reference is likely intended to mean the behavior of std::map::upper_bound, according to which an iterator to the first entry whose key is greater than the passed search argument is returned.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Boundary Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  With regard to error behavior, the element is explicitly declared in the specification as “not exception safe” [SWS_CORE_01505]. Specific DET or DEM messages as well as error codes are not provided. Callers must take into account that no exception safety guarantees are granted if exceptions occur [SWS_CORE_01505].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interaction and related requirements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The template search function for const containers complements three further overloads of upper_bound within ara::core::Map:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The non-const basic search iterator upper_bound(const key_type &x) with fixed key type [SWS_CORE_01502].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The const basic search const_iterator upper_bound(const key_type &x) const [SWS_CORE_01503].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The non-const template overload template <class K> iterator upper_bound(const K &x) for mutable instances [SWS_CORE_01504].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Compared to [SWS_CORE_01503], the template signature of [SWS_CORE_01505] enables heterogeneous search operations on const instances without having to create temporary objects of type key_type.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
    The function value_comp is a member function of class ara::core::Map in module core and is included via header file #include "ara/core/map.h" [SWS_CORE_01489]. It has the signature value_compare value_comp () const;, takes no parameters, and synchronously returns a comparison object of type value_compare [SWS_CORE_01489]. According to the specification, the behavior is according to the corresponding usage in [map] [SWS_CORE_01489]; interpretation: analogous to the C++ standard container std::map, this is likely to provide a function object that compares two elements (key-value pairs) based on their keys.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
    The specification notes that the function is not exception-safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_01489]. Specific error codes, differing return values in case of error, or AUTOSAR diagnostic notifications (such as DET or DEM) are not provided for this call.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Concurrency and Constraints
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
    As a const member method (const), value_comp does not modify the logical state of the instance of ara::core::Map [SWS_CORE_01489]. Due to the classification as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_01489], users should nevertheless note that no guarantees are given regarding the integrity of the state in the event of an exception. The specification does not mention specific ordering requirements or reentrancy specifications.
